observations: This is an instrumented QA-only lease observation, not a clean-main pass for Q11-F1a. Clean coder/agent-relay main base 43a513659711f0a31bf1522a233c041df475bd4e plus the exact uncommitted git diff in evidence/qa-source-git-diff.json produced the launched QA binary SHA-256 07fc442011747bacda6445c14823baacf3237bd0daeb04a2a3e85d6b7edc930d. The exact uncommitted git diff is stored losslessly in the evidence JSON field `git_diff`. Focused Go and race tests passed. Only qa-claude attempt 0's local watcher gained one minute; Relay continued advertising expected_spawn_seconds=300. The original attempt's JWT expiry and all later-attempt deadlines remained unchanged.

One benign prompt was sent in a new Claude conversation in the tester-confirmed Steven-Testing environment; Enter was by 18:51:15.443Z, with only an approximate UI-derived lower bound near 18:51:07Z. Private verified attempt 0 had iat=18:51:11Z, exp=18:56:11Z. Build 1 entered the 480-second delay at 18:51:18.938Z. It remained running after exp with no attempt-0 local nack or runner. One real provider re-offer arrived at 18:56:16.832435381Z, with signed attempt 1 iat=18:56:16Z and exp=19:01:16Z, a fresh five-minute budget. No second prompt or manual retry caused it.

Relay reconciled the same sole QA workspace: it canceled build 1, whose running Terraform job finished failed with canceled_at, then created build 2 on that workspace with agent_relay_attempt=1 and the 480-second delay. Build 2 remained running past the instrumented first-watcher deadline 18:57:11Z; no attempt-0 stale nack or premature delete appeared in private Relay logs or the QA-scoped status monitor. The provider UI still showed waiting and one failed attempt by an observation between 18:57:48.905 and 18:58:05.143Z; it does not prove an exact provider failure time.

At attempt 1's actual exp 19:01:16Z, Relay logged an applied non-retryable attempt-1 nack at 19:01:16.221130728Z, then Coder marked canceled_at=19:01:16.279219Z and terminal failed=19:01:16.781838Z for build 2. Relay queued natural deletion at 19:01:19.615726563Z; no QA workspace remained by the 19:01:31.633591Z poll. The UI showed Failed after 2 attempts by an observation between 19:02:02.686 and 19:02:10.824Z. The first failed attempt is consistent with provider lease expiry, the second with attempt-1 nack; the spinner remained visible and is not separately diagnosed.

Raw work orders, account claims, private Relay and Coder build logs, original UI captures and full status monitor records remain private. The three browser screenshots are attached only to the private tester chat; no unreviewed pixels are committed. The redacted public log excerpt and 234 pseudonymous status polls support the event timeline. The safe byte-identical QA config and original clean-main launcher were restored, the QA Relay restarted, both labeled pool-health gauges were one, and zero steven QA template workspaces remained at the final read-only check. Cursor was not prompted.
